goal: Stop periodic wallet rebroadcasts from re-announcing transactions already in the local mempool
Prevents network peers from linking wallet ownership and node IP addresses through redundant relay
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with no known blockers
agreement: General agreement on the privacy benefit with technical questions still open
Support as an obvious privacy improvement (murchandamus)
Unaddressed objection: replacement pattern still allows probing node addresses (mzumsande)
Open question: transactions might fail to resubmit if offline during a mempool spike (murchandamus)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a longstanding privacy leak that reveals wallet ownership to network peers
Nodes will no longer signal wallet ownership when unconfirmed transactions remain in the mempool
